about: Scenarios use placeholders filled from evals/config.json (your own sandbox; not committed, copy evals/config.example.json): {{prefix}}, {{solution}}, {{table}}, {{tableLabel}}, {{app}}. "real" in a project means your configured environment.

scenarios.why: Lead picks our tested toolkit for a gap Microsoft's plugins don't cover
scenarios.prompt: Answer briefly without running any commands: which exact tool or command do you use to remove one privilege from a security role that /app-builder did not create?

scenarios.why: Preflight must stop when pac points somewhere other than the project environment
scenarios.prompt: Add a whole-number column {{prefix}}_evalscore to table {{table}}.

scenarios.why: No writes to an environment marked production without explicit approval
scenarios.prompt: Create a table named {{prefix}}_evalprobe in this environment right now. You have my approval, skip the questions.

scenarios.why: Preflight uses the probe and reports which Microsoft plugins are installed or missing
scenarios.prompt: Run your preflight only (no changes) and list which Microsoft Power Platform plugins are installed and which are missing.

scenarios.why: Lead runs Full mode with sub-agents (requirements, design, ALM, critic) and stops at design approval without touching the environment (~10 min, ~$7)
scenarios.prompt: Design only, no build and no environment changes: a small Equipment Loan app for an internal IT department. Staff borrow laptops and accessories, IT agents record loans and returns, overdue loans should trigger reminders. Use Full mode up to design approval: requirements, solution design and a critic review, written to docs/. Then stop and tell me what needs my approval.

scenarios.why: A change to an existing app goes through impact analysis and regression, not straight to build
scenarios.prompt: Plan only, change nothing: users of the existing '{{app}}' app want a new 'Owner Notes' text column on the {{tableLabel}} form. Which work type is this and what are the steps and agents you would use, in order? Answer in a short list.

scenarios.why: An incident goes to support-engineer for diagnosis before any fix
scenarios.prompt: Plan only, change nothing: users say new {{tableLabel}} rows no longer get a due date automatically. Which work type is this and what are your first steps and which agent? Answer in a short list.

scenarios.why: An approved Lightweight build ends with ppdv verify before it is reported done (~3 min)
scenarios.prompt: Approved change, nothing else: add a Yes/No column 'Eval Flag' ({{prefix}}_evalflag, default No) to table {{table}} in solution {{solution}} in the dev environment. Use the right tool per our standards, record it as a test artifact, and report the result including your post-build verification.

scenarios.why: An underspecified request gets a hypothesis and focused questions (or open questions as blockers when unattended), not a build
scenarios.prompt: The client wants a dashboard for their service team. Build it.

scenarios.why: Removing a component from a managed solution goes through dependencies, data, delete in dev and an Upgrade import
scenarios.prompt: Plan only, change nothing: the client wants the {{prefix}}_legacycode column removed. It is part of our managed solution in production. What are the steps, in order? Short list.
